scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the six-component model, the definitions of the androgen and PSA right-hand sides, Table 1, the numerical derivation, the final component recurrences, and the statement connecting Figures 1--7 to the scheme. The cited method paper and its author correction were checked for relevant corrections. An exact rational checker replays the source-parameter consistency witness. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding concerns the recurrence printed in Section 5. No simulation source code is supplied, so the implementation used for the figures may already have used the correct PSA field. No claim is made about the other component recurrences or the general convergence theory of the underlying fractional method.

title: The printed fractional prostate-cancer scheme numerically slaves PSA to androgen
